title: Evaluating a Learned Admission-Prediction Model as a Replacement for Standardized Tests in College Admissions
reasoning: The paper discusses algorithmic fairness and the ethical implications of using sensitive attributes (including 'religious preference') in AI models for college admissions. However, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics themselves; rather, it considers the ethical implications of AI system design and its impact on fairness and bias.
